style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, warm analog film grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling. No text, no captions, no inscriptions, no readable letters, no film stock branding, no Kodak or Portra labels, no frame numbers, no aspect ratio markers, no watermarks. No modern objects, no asphalt, no painted road markings, no vehicles, no cars, no motorcycles, no machinery. No human figures, no faces, no body parts, no hands. 1st-century Mediterranean Levantine setting only.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: The Dishonest Manager
images.concept: Using worldly wealth to make friends for eternity — shrewdness in service of what actually lasts
images.imageAlt: A stack of old papyrus scrolls, one partially unrolled on a stone surface, oil lamp light warming the scene
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a stack of old papyrus rolls on a worn stone surface, one scroll partially unrolled and lying across the others, the surface of the unrolled scroll blank — no text visible, just the material itself, a small oil lamp casting warm amber light across the arrangement from just outside the frame, heavy warm analog film grain, muted warm palette of aged papyrus and pale stone and amber lamp glow, the accounts spread open — the moment of shrewd reconsideration, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Law and Prophets
images.concept: Not one stroke of the law passes away — the kingdom intensifies rather than dissolves what was written
images.imageAlt: Ancient stone surface with carved marks worn nearly smooth but still perceptible under raking light, the stone cracked but unbroken
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close-up of an ancient stone surface with carved marks worn nearly smooth by time but still perceptible under strong raking side light, the light revealing the carved depressions that centuries of weathering have not erased, the stone slightly cracked but intact, the marks enduring, heavy warm analog film grain in the stone texture, muted warm palette of pale stone and deep shadow in the carved marks, endurance against time — words that outlast the stone, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: The Rich Man and Lazarus
images.concept: A gate between two worlds — and the great reversal that cannot be undone after death
images.imageAlt: A heavy ornate gate half-open, the interior side lit with warm amber, the exterior in cold shadow, a worn stone threshold between them
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a heavy decorative iron gate standing half-open in a stone wall, the interior side illuminated with warm amber light suggesting luxury within, the exterior side of the gate in cold blue-gray shadow, the stone threshold between interior and exterior worn and marked by generations of crossing, heavy warm analog film grain in both light zones, muted palette of warm amber interior and cool shadow exterior, the gate and its threshold — the boundary that hardens to an unbridgeable chasm, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9
